text:
# CellPainter

CellPainter: A visualization tool for multiplex fluorescent imaging signatures, mapping cellular morphological changes in response to drugs or mutations.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: profile_wells processes supplied five-channel images into classical morphology/texture features; legacy signatures are hand-specified. Visualization renderer exists but actual pixels not inspected in this tranche.

text: It identifies unique staining patterns associated with specific biological perturbations.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Image-feature and reference-pattern paths exist, not universal perturbation specificity. nearest_mechanism has insertion-order defect reproduced separately.

text: CellPainter enables the discovery of novel drug mechanisms and the characterization of phenotypes by comparing image data across experimental conditions.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Comparison/novel_mechanism_hint output does not validate a novel mechanism or phenotype cause. No held-out novel-drug validation established; feature order can change similarity.

text:
# CellPainter 4D

CellPainter 4D: A temporal simulation engine for cell morphology that models how cell shapes and features change over time.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Fixed-clock ODE plus seeded population simulation exists; no learned/validated biological prediction claimed.

text: It provides event timelines and numerical traces of morphological drift during differentiation.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Event timelines/frames/drift output; suite tests closed-form relaxation, fixed-hour observation-window invariance and unobserved events. Independent six-image BBBC001 count check 8.1824% deviation, not temporal dynamics validation.

text: CellPainter 4D offers a dynamic view of responses, helping researchers understand the temporal sequence of cellular morphological changes.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Simulation outputs may help exploration, but understanding benefit or true biological temporal response not measured.
